semantics.clock: positive edge; q stays unchanged on falling edges and between rising edges
semantics.a_high: Synchronously set q to 4, evidenced at 5,15,25,35 ns
semantics.a_low: Advance q by one modulo 7; 4 -> 5 -> 6 -> 0 -> 1 at 55,65,75,85 ns
semantics.initialization: No reset port or initialization: q unknown at 0 ns until first high-a rising edge
semantics.45ns_sampling: a falls at the 45 ns rising-edge timestamp after the edge samples its previous high value; q remains 4. First edge sampling low a is 55 ns.

verification.oracle: Original table replayed at all timestamps 0 through 90 ns, checked after edge updates
verification.timing: clk toggles every 5 ns; a changes at 45 ns after rising-edge sampling, in NBA phase
verification.directed: Continue through all seven states and another wrap; synchronous load at nonzero states; check no asynchronous changes and no falling-edge updates
verification.timeout: Bounded simulation with fatal on any mismatch and PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities.issue: The tabular waveform does not specify delta-cycle ordering of simultaneous clk/a changes at 45 ns
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Replay a fall in NBA after the clock edge, consistent with observed q=4 at45 and q=5 at55; use synchronous load/count behavior.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Transitions from states 1,2,3 and state7 are not directly shown
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Infer modulo-7 counting from 4,5,6,0,1; state7 is unreachable after the shown load and is not assigned special recovery behavior.
